quests.title: One bed, ready for the next
quests.ask: Write `plant_bed()`: starting on the bed's first cell facing east, plant the bed, then end on the path where the next bed starts, facing east.
quests.nudge: Where it ends is where the next call starts. Which way does the robot face after the last flower?

quests.title: Two beds in a row
quests.ask: Plant the first two beds along the path, so the second one comes out the same shape as the first.
quests.nudge: If the second bed goes wrong, look at where the first call leaves the robot.

quests.title: All three beds, then the gate
quests.ask: Plant every bed and finish at the gate on the far east end, facing east.
quests.nudge: Once the last bed is planted, how far is it still to the gate?
